title: Partition Array Into Two Arrays to Minimize Sum Difference
goal: Split an even-length array into two equally sized groups with minimum sum difference.
strategy: Enumerate subset sums separately for each half, grouped by selected count. Pair complementary counts and binary-search the right-half sum closest to half the total minus the chosen left sum.
